key_insight: A single, scalable training recipe yields consistent forecast-quality improvements from 4M to 2.5B parameters — Toto 2.0 is a family of five open-weight time‑series foundation models that set new SOTA on BOOM, GIFT‑Eval and TIME.
problem_solved: Provides a reliable, reproducible path to scale time‑series forecasting models and close the gap between small research models and large foundation models for forecasting.
method: Design and apply one unified training recipe across a family of five models spanning 4M–2.5B parameters.
Scale model capacity while keeping the training pipeline fixed to demonstrate predictable gains in forecast quality.
Evaluate extensively on three benchmarks (BOOM, GIFT‑Eval, contamination‑resistant TIME) and release open weights for reproducibility.
impact: Practitioners get ready-to-use, scalable forecasting foundation models that improve accuracy and robustness across diverse tasks, simplifying model selection and accelerating deployment of time‑series solutions.
visual_elements: Line chart: performance (metric) versus model size (4M → 2.5B) showing monotonic improvement
Benchmark comparison bars: Toto 2.0 versus prior SOTA on BOOM, GIFT‑Eval, and TIME
Pipeline diagram: single 'training recipe' flow (data → preprocessing/augmentation → model family → evaluation)
Icon set: open weights, reproducibility, and contamination‑resilience badges
paper_title: Toto 2.0: Time Series Forecasting Enters the Scaling Era
paper_authors: Emaad Khwaja, Chris Lettieri, Gerald Woo, Eden Belouadah, Marc Cenac
